text: UI-G (2026-09-26): Studio's RecordNumber is header-excluded (record 7,214), while core's wire numbers are header-inclusive (7,215) CsvRecord values. When UI-G G1 lands, retype RecordNumber to eyes4s DataRecord and convert at the backend boundary with CsvRecord.of / RecordRole. DiagnosticLocus.Record must carry DataRecord. The fake uses header-excluded numbers throughout, so the drift appears only on the real backend.
